name: TEagle 3.8.1 prospective publication benchmark
description: Frozen pre-execution suite for the prospective TEagle 3.8.1 publication benchmark. It prespecifies 109 unique-hash external holdout cases, 100 Level D negative challenge units from 85 public accessions, two Level B deterministic controls, structural and ERV/Gypsy truth, three de-novo primer-design loci, descriptive exact-construct truth for 12 of the 30 bundled domain models, one frozen TEsorter comparator configuration, random seeds, statistical analyses, provenance checks and clean-machine requirements. The archive contains no TEagle or comparator benchmark results. It includes only the exact public FASTA inputs referenced by the manifests so execution remains self-contained with network access disabled; source and reuse terms are recorded in the included rights notices. Unreferenced caches, machine paths, credentials, manuscript files and internal reports are excluded.
